title: Apple Announces First Touchscreen MacBook Pro
excerpt: Apple reveals its first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro at the "Pro and tell" event, featuring a new ProLED XDR display.
body_html:
Apple has officially introduced its first touchscreen MacBook during the "Pro and tell" event. The company showcased the long-awaited feature in a video highlighting the new device in action.

According to the announcement, the updated laptop comes equipped with a ProLED XDR touch display. The reveal gives users a first look at how touch functionality is integrated into the new MacBook Pro model.
